description: This class includes the manufacture of various products not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of protective safety equipment: helmets, safety harnesses, life vests
manufacture of pens, pencils, fountain pens, felt-tip pens and other similar articles
manufacture of pencil leads, crayons, pastels, chalks
manufacture of artificial flowers, fruit and foliage
manufacture of buttons, press-studs, snap fasteners, hooks and eyes, buckles
manufacture of walking sticks and canes
manufacture of cigarette lighters and parts thereof
manufacture of typewriter and similar ribbons
manufacture of wigs, false beards, eyebrows
manufacture of goods not elsewhere classified: rosaries, coffins, floral wreaths, taxidermy items
